sloka: तं गुणैस्समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः ।सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन् दुःखमात्मजम् ॥२-१९-३९॥
transliteration: taṁ guṇaissamatāṁ prāpto bhrātā vipulavikramaḥ ।saumitriranuvavrāja dhārayan duḥkhamātmajam ॥2-19-39॥

translations.english: Mighty Lakshmana as virtuous as his brother held the sorrow in his mind and followed him.
